id: title:adamleithp:menu indicator contrast destructive items button press

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies visual behavior and accessibility implementation of destructive menu items and active button press feedback, aiding maintainers and users in understanding UI consistency.
review.reason: The change group consists of three hunks: P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 update comments to clarify that destructive menu items use Button's filled destructive variant, while P1.F3.H1 adds CSS for active button press feedback. These are localized, bounded implementation and documentation updates. No systemic risk reduction or broader capability expansion is demonstrated. The score is 1, not
review.uncertainty: The tier assignment relies on the supplied observations; no unverified outcomes or adoption metrics are inferred. The connection to PostHog relevance is established through the observed code, but the actual benefit is not independently verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Documentation and implementation change: removed the comment that destructive menu items use red text at rest; added the comment that they now use Button's filled destructive variant. P1.F2.H1.
observations.code_quote: Destructive items (`variant="destructive"` on DropdownMenuItem/ContextMenuItem/MenubarItem) forward straight to Button's `destructive` variant, so a delete row in a menu reads exactly like a standalone destructive Button: a red fill at rest, brighter on hover or keyboard highlight. The item owns that mapping — don't pass a Button variant through `render` to restyle a menu item.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the visual behavior of destructive menu items, which could help maintainers understand the intended accessibility and visual consistency, though this is documentation rather than a correctness fix.

observations.behavior: Documentation and implementation change: removed the comment that destructive menu items use red text at rest; added the comment that they now use Button's filled destructive variant. P1.F2.H2.
observations.code_quote: MenubarItem wraps DropdownMenuItem, so the same item API applies — including `variant="destructive"` (Button's filled destructive look).
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the visual behavior of destructive menu items, which could help maintainers understand the intended accessibility and visual consistency, though this is documentation rather than a correctness fix.

observations.behavior: Adds CSS for active button press feedback: the button translates 1px down when active, except for variants that have their own motion. P1.F3.H1.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a visual affordance for button press, which could help users perceive clickability and distinguish active state, though this is a minor UI enhancement rather than a critical correctness or accessibility fix.
